snippet.title: LarsGadiel - Release Date Trailer | PS5, PS4, Xbox, Nintendo Switch
snippet.description:
LarsGadiel, the lost 8-bit prequel to Xenon Valkyrie, is coming to PS5, PS4, Xbox One and Nintendo Switch on December 4th, 2026!

Originally designed as a true 8-bit NES game by Diabolical Mind, it was never released... until now! A classic Metroidvania with a huge maze-like world full of secrets, plus an exclusive second world and a New Game+ mode for consoles.

Also playable on Xbox Series X|S and Nintendo Switch 2 via backward compatibility. PS4/PS5 cross-buy.

Wishlist now:
PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10021113
Nintendo eShop: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/larsgadiel-switch/
Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/games/store/larsgadiel/9P1BL4MWKFBS

$9.99 / 9,99 €
Developed by Diabolical Mind, ported and published by COWCAT.
All our games: https://linktr.ee/cowcatgames
